scope: S5 implement step1.6 harness heartbeat repair; no acceptance claim

behavior.credential: enrolled mdt_ scoped to actor0/runtime; no token logging
behavior.trigger_observation: GET /api/runtimes?owner=me using actor0 human token and execution workspace header, before trigger timestamp and both measurement clocks
behavior.failure: runtime_offline or distinct heartbeat/state/identity/fixture-lifetime code; no fresh enrollment/retry key
behavior.cleanup: close sockets; close/settle daemon; abort/join heartbeat; restore and read gate; finish both full sample denominators and close logs

named_tests: heartbeat uses the enrolled owner's scoped credential, repeats below freshness, and stops its timer
heartbeat refuses another owner or an expired credential before any transport call
heartbeat records HTTP, malformed acknowledgement, and transport failures without leaking response content
heartbeat cleanup aborts and awaits an in-flight request without treating cancellation as a failed beat
heartbeat remains single-flight and keeps a failed beat after a later successful retry
heartbeat log failure settles readiness and cleanup instead of leaking a background rejection
writeback heartbeat and offline failures keep both full denominators and finish all cleanup
offline and stale runtime reads cannot become a generic no-provider launch or a passing sample
nearest-rank uses the integer rank ceil(N*95/100) for N=100, 10000 and 20
a missing sample enters the percentile as +Infinity instead of shrinking the denominator
more than five percent missing makes p95 unbounded
any missing sample fails the sync gate even when every percentile is finite and fast
a duplicate event_id is counted and never yields a second arrival
only collaboration:changed with exactly sequence S+1 for this issue matches
a frame that arrives before the write response keeps its original arrival time
without the matching frame an authoritative read alone is never a converged sample
warm-up rows are retained but never enter or replace the formal denominator
an aborted run keeps the 10,000 denominator and reports the remainder as NOT_RUN
a failed write or failed preparation marks all 100 samples of that event non-converged
pooled p95 and per-event slowest-observer p95 are judged separately
accounting refuses duplicated pairs, impossible indices and relabelled late samples
the two write-back gates are independent and each needs a complete denominator
phase jitter is seeded, reproducible, inside [0,500) and not phase locked
registration pacing never plans more than 30 attempts in one server window
write-back readers are never the triggering account or the resource owner
the quiescence barrier accepts a delivered frame or a snapshot that already covers the sequence
the relay-time revision in a frame is recorded as an anomaly, never used to match
a manifest that changes the pre-registered protocol is rejected

static.first_eslint_reason: Six no-undef violations in test loader Node globals; fixed with Node imports and globalThis AbortController/AbortSignal.

expiry_audit.handling: Owner-bound managed heartbeat immediately after enrollment, then 15s after each completed request; 10s request timeout. Exact online runtime/owner/workspace/daemon and last_seen checked before triggers.
Uses issued mdt_ credential whose principal_user_id equals actor0. Actual expires_at recorded; expired or <=10s remaining refuses start/send. No renewal or re-enrollment.
Requested with expires_in_days:1; used only for installation binding before the measurement, never heartbeat.

Fresh login for all100 participants at each phase; AUTH_TOKEN_TTL is configurable. No silent token refresh or identity substitution. Actual r02 configuration is coordinator-owned and not accessed here.
Consumed during immediate enrollment/binding before measurement. No periodic renewal required.

Unchanged. Records start-request/ready times. Refuses next trigger or classifies missing launch as host_fixture_lifetime_elapsed once elapsed since readiness reaches5min (conservative lower bound on process age). No restart or timeout extension.

expiry_audit.item: Provider callback and individual Agent timeout
expiry_audit.handling: Fresh callback/deadline per run; one business and one finalization sample each have unchanged30s cutoff. No relaxation.

No wall-clock TTL in these selected claim/permit capability rows; exact run/fence/claim generation/attempt and revocation/confirmation are authoritative. Reservations release only through existing proven-end contract. No keepalive-generated permit, synthetic proof or reservation reset.
Existing authentication/subscription ACKs and native ping response remain. Boundary-only reconnect remains measured as existing recovery; heartbeat never uses reader sockets or tokens.

preserved: all product code and default freshness/pool/timeout values
not_run: production Web/Desktop or final S5/TC24 acceptance
limitations: In-memory transport/timer/daemon tests prove harness decisions, not live server permission enforcement or sustained real heartbeat delivery.

Production daemon uses an initial jitter and ticker; this one-runtime harness uses an immediate readiness beat then15s after completion, at most25s with normal bounded I/O excluding event-loop stalls. Heartbeat overhead is retained in measured time, not subtracted.
Existing5-minute host fixture context remains a possible rehearsal boundary and has not been extended.
Disk/OS failures preventing evidence append can still prevent complete artifacts; heartbeat log failure itself is sticky and joined, no background rejection.
